results.title: AI Engineer, Supply Chain Intelligence
results.description: SANDBOX FIXTURE POSTING — not a real job. Northwind Telecom is hiring an AI Engineer for our Supply Chain Intelligence group in Budapest. You will build and ship generative-AI and machine-learning services that plug into our ERP and planning systems, working directly with supply chain planners to turn manual processes into automated ones. Requirements: strong Python (pandas), SQL, hands-on experience fine-tuning LLMs, Azure Machine Learning, and the ability to explain a model's business impact to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Power BI, document-processing pipelines, process-automation experience. English is the working language; no Hungarian required.

results.title: Data Scientist — Operations
results.description: SANDBOX FIXTURE POSTING — not a real job. Kestrel Analytics is a fully remote EU team building forecasting products for logistics operators. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own demand and inventory forecasting models end to end: framing the problem with the operations team, building the model in Python, and putting it in front of users in a dashboard they trust. Requirements: Python, SQL, applied forecasting or predictive modelling experience, comfort with messy operational data. Nice to have: Power BI or a similar BI tool, supply chain domain knowledge, experience automating reporting. We sponsor work permits for candidates already resident in the EU.
